title: Italian Bravas Frittata
description: A flavorful Italian frittata filled with roasted bravas peppers and onions, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Roast the bravas pepper in the oven for 30 minutes, then peel and chop it.
In a large skillet, cook the lonion over medium heat until softened.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped pepper, cooked lonion, and Parmesan cheese to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9-inch pie plate.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the frittata is golden brown.
Let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
